text:
- Take 10 mg lisinopril every morning.
- Call 911 if you have chest pain.

- Change the wound dressing once daily.
- Avoid heavy lifting for 2 weeks.

- Check your blood pressure twice daily. Target < 140/90 mmHg.
- Record values in a log.

- Do not drive for 24 hours after sedation.
- Use assistance when walking if dizzy.

- Take metformin 500 mg with breakfast and dinner.
- Skip the dose if you are fasting for labs.

- Follow up with the cardiology clinic in 7 days.
- Bring all medications to the visit.

- If you have trouble breathing or chest pain, call 911.
- New or severe bleeding: go to the emergency department.

- Keep the incision clean and dry.
- Shower after 48 hours; no baths for 2 weeks.

- Take ibuprofen 200 mg every 6 hours as needed for pain.
- Do not exceed 1200 mg in 24 hours.

- Schedule a clinic appointment in 10 days.
- Call if fever > 38.0 C or chills.

- Use the inhaler: 2 puffs every 4 hours as needed for wheeze.
- If no relief and breathing worsens, call 911.

- Start walking 10 minutes twice daily. Increase by 5 minutes each week.
- Stop if you feel chest pain or dizziness.

- Remove bandage after 24 hours.
- Apply new dressing if soaked with blood.

- Avoid alcohol while taking antibiotics.
- Finish the course: 7 days total.
